sample.goal: Get strong, move well, recover enough to do it again. That is the whole game.
sample.note.bags: Bag rounds for conditioning: three minutes hard, one minute off.
sample.note.barre: Balance and the small muscles, slow and exact.
sample.note.cable: Rows, presses and the small work that keeps shoulders healthy.
sample.note.cardio: Ten easy minutes to warm up. Conditioning days finish on the air bike.
sample.note.clientWall: Every client's best lift this year, written up on the wall.
sample.note.desk: Where we start: last week's notes and how you slept.
sample.note.freeWeights: Dumbbells and kettlebells for the accessory work, paired up so the hour keeps moving.
sample.note.frontDesk: Check in here. We read last week's notes before we start.
sample.note.kettlebells: Swings, carries and goblet squats, paired so the hour keeps moving.
sample.note.machines: For what a barbell can't load well: hamstrings, upper back, a pump to finish.
sample.note.mats: Mobility to start, core work to finish.
sample.note.meetHere: We meet here whatever the weather. Bring water and a layer.
sample.note.platform: Deadlifts and cleans. We film the top set and go through it together after.
sample.note.rack: Squats and presses, worked up to one heavy set.
sample.note.reformers: Reformer work for control and strength through the whole range.
sample.note.rig: Pull-ups, rows and hangs. Everyone leaves with stronger hands.
sample.note.ring: Pad work and footwork drills, in three-minute rounds.
sample.note.speaker: Music on, phones away. Bring your playlist if you like.
sample.note.squatRack: Squats, presses and pull-ups, worked up to one heavy set.
sample.note.squatRacks: Most sessions start here: a squat or a press, worked up to one heavy set.
sample.note.turf: Sled pushes and carries. The last ten minutes, most days.
sample.offer.program: A program written for your week
sample.program.basics.name: Barbell basics
sample.program.basics.note: For a first year under the bar: two days a week, every lift taught from the start.
sample.program.bells.name: Bike and bells
sample.program.bells.note: Twenty-five minutes, twice a week, for the weeks with no time.
sample.program.engine.name: Engine 8
sample.program.engine.note: Three days a week. The intervals get longer every two weeks, and the rest gets shorter.
sample.program.strong.name: Strong in 12
sample.program.strong.note: Three lifting days a week. Every top set is filmed and gets a note back.
sample.replay.bike.body: Forty seconds on, eighty off. Held the pace to the last round, so next week the rest gets shorter.
sample.replay.bike.title: Air bike intervals
sample.replay.circuit.body: Four rounds of a sled push, a farmer carry and ten burpees. Every round faster than the one before.
sample.replay.circuit.title: Sled, carries and burpees
sample.replay.press.body: Feet set, shoulder blades pinned, a one-second pause on the chest. Five clean sets.
sample.replay.press.title: Bench press, fives
sample.replay.pull.body: Pulled from a dead stop every rep, no bounce. Rows strict, chest on the bench.
sample.replay.pull.title: Deadlift and rows
sample.replay.squat.body: Paused the first rep of every set. Bar speed held to the last triple, so it goes up next week.
sample.replay.squat.title: Back squat, heavy triples
sample.replay.swings.body: Thirty swings at the top of every two minutes. Hips snap, arms just hold on.
sample.replay.swings.title: Kettlebell swings, every two minutes
sample.review.r1: +60 lb on my deadlift in 14 weeks without a single bad-back day.
sample.review.r2: World-class programming. Books up fast, so plan ahead. It's worth it.
sample.review.r3: Every session has a note waiting after. I finally know why the program is the program.
sample.review.r4: Never touched a barbell before. Eight months later I pulled twice my bodyweight.
sample.workout.deadlift.body: Bar over mid-foot, slack out of the bar, then push the floor away.
sample.workout.deadlift.title: Deadlift set-up
sample.workout.row.body: Long strokes, legs first. Hold the same split for every interval.
sample.workout.row.title: Rower pacing
sample.workout.squat.body: Brace, sit between the hips, stand up the same way you went down.
sample.workout.squat.title: Back squat, what I look for
sample.workout.swings.body: Hips snap, arms just hold on. Stop the set when the bell drifts.
sample.workout.swings.title: Kettlebell swings

sample.nutri.offer.notes: Notes on the meals you log
sample.nutri.offer.plan: A meal plan written for your week
sample.nutri.review.n1: First plan I have kept past week two. I cook three times a week now and eat well all seven days.
sample.nutri.review.n2: Fuelled my first marathon without a single wall. The race-week plan was gold.
sample.nutri.review.n3: Every meal I log gets read, and the notes are short and useful. No food guilt, ever.
sample.nutri.review.n4: Down 9 kg in five months and I still eat pasta on Fridays.
